selection_rule: PROTOCOL.md; outcome-blind eligibility and repetition counts; alphabetical tie break
metadata_observations_before_statistics: All four aliases are from one vendor; no substitution to create artificial provider diversity.
human_source contains baseline and estimate; all imported weights are provisional, not newly calibrated IWU-E60.
Scaffold metadata contains missing values and different scaffolds; retrospective scores characterize recorded alias mixtures, not controlled base models.
generation_cost is a source field, not proven complete episode cost; label model-cost proxy only.
Do not reinterpret time-horizon analysis as an IWU validation by the source authors.
